title: 第七章 忤逆子主母和母亲第八章 民乱
content_zh:
虽然陆宁说不用人跟随，但刘汉常还是选了四名会骑马的差役，加上他，跟随陆宁出城。
甘二郎同样在队伍里，和一名差役合骑一匹马，稀里糊涂的跟随陆宁到了明湖庄园外，才渐渐回神。
看这俊美少年郎威势，定然就是新县令了，若不然他哪有权力赦免自己？又回来这明湖庄园？
也就是，自己那苦命的妹妹，是被发与他为奴了？!
然后，他便心中暗喜，我就说嘛，妹妹如此端庄美貌，又有哪个男人不动心？看来这位新明府，自也对妹妹有意，所以爱屋及乌，赦免了自己。
虽说妹妹由主母而为妾，但终究这滔天灭门之灾，有了转机。
何况这位明府大人比那刘逆，年轻了有数旬，更生得英俊，妹妹便是与之为妾，也比给那刘逆做夫人守活寡要强上数倍了。
看着旁侧和自己同样在外面等候的刘汉常，甘二郎赔笑道：“看来，明府这人，甚是宽厚啊！”
刘汉常笑了笑，“二郎，一直没机会和你说，以后咱们东海，没有明府了，只有国主，你说的明府，就是国主第下，听到了吗？以后称第下！圣天子封东海国，国主第下为县公。”
甘二郎一呆：“啊？”一时没反应过来。
封国？这是哪朝哪代的事情了？
县公？二品尊位？
就方才的少年郎？
甘二郎突然就觉得腿肚子有些软。
可随之，又欣喜若狂，妹妹，是国主的奴婢了？若真成了妾侍，可，可真是进了朱门！
若再得宠！
整个甘家，可不要飞黄腾达了？
……
明湖庄园，亭宇楼榭，甚为精美，有江南明苑之风。
此时内宅客堂中，烛光如豆，甘氏和李氏都没有睡，在等陆宁回转。

甘氏刚刚接了李氏，按陆宁吩咐，都住进了这别苑，她还有些事，想询问陆宁。
和外间的消息一直闭塞，刚刚才听说，好像自己的二哥被抓入了大牢。
甘氏心急如焚，虽然这个哥哥，性子浮夸，但毕竟是血亲。
甘氏想，能不能求求陆宁，放过自己的二哥，也许，他能看在过去自己对他家回护的情分上，答应自己？
可是，如果他回绝，自己脸面现在本就无所谓，但二哥，他哪里能吃得了监牢的苦？怕没几天，就会病死。
看着幽幽烛光，李氏却极为心疼，说：“主母，还是，还是将蜡炬熄了吧……”
“老夫人，你，你不要再如此称呼奴。”甘氏回神。
她面对陆宁，尚有矜持，从头到尾，未称呼陆宁为“主君”或“主人”，也不曾自称为奴为婢，虽恪守奴婢之礼，应答自称合乎礼节，但自有其矜持。
只是，在这个对自己还是恭敬异常的慈祥妇人面前，甘氏却没有了那些矜持，实则便是以往，她又何尝不希望有李氏这样一个慈爱的母亲，便如疼爱其儿子一样疼爱自己怜惜自己，而不似自己亲人，为了家族更为兴旺，要将自己送给一个糟老头子联姻。
是以，将李氏奉为母亲一样尊重，她并没有什么纠结的。
但是李氏，心里却别扭极了，以前高高在上的主母，现今却成了自己的奴婢，对自己三步一鞠躬五步一磕头的，她直觉得若时日长了，自己怕是要折寿。
听李氏要熄灭蜡炬，甘氏应了一声，聘婷来到烛台前，“老夫人可早些歇息，明日晨起，也能见到县公第下！”一边说一边准备吹灭蜡烛。
便在此时，外面匆匆脚步声响，却是甘氏以前贴身婢女小翠，跑进来急急的道：“主母……”随之省起，忙拜倒，对李氏道：“老夫人，主君回来了！”
她的主母本是喊甘氏，突然回神，要说她和甘氏，本是主仆，现今却同为婢女，这种身份转换，对她也是煎熬，在人后她仍然以主母对甘氏，但在人前，却是要同等身份，这令她很有心理负担。
同样，甘氏面对小翠，又何尝不是极为羞愧，主母变为婢女，面对自己以前的婢女，这种心情，又是何等窘迫？
说话间，外面已经有脚步声，陆宁大步走入，见母亲也没睡，微怔后见礼，说道：“娘亲，儿要带甘夫人出去一趟，您早些歇息。”
现在这个世界，夜间赶路特别凶险，对母亲来说就更是如此了，从县城到甘家村虽然仅仅三十多里路程，但老妈知道自己赶夜路，那得担心死。
content_en:
Although Lu Ning said he didn't need anyone to follow him, Liu Hanchang still selected four servants who could ride horses, plus him, to follow Lu Ning out of the city.
Gan Erlang was also in the team, riding a horse with a servant, and followed Lu Ning in a daze to the outside of Minghu Manor before he gradually regained consciousness.
Judging from the power of this handsome young man, he must be the new county magistrate. Otherwise, how would he have the power to pardon himself? Come back to Minghu Manor again?
In other words, was his miserable sister sent to be a slave to him? !
Then, he was secretly happy, let me just say, what man wouldn't be tempted by my sister who is so dignified and beautiful? It seems that this Xinming Mansion was also interested in his sister, so he loved the whole family and pardoned himself.
Although the younger sister was turned into a concubine by the mistress, the disaster of destroying the family finally turned around.
What's more, this Lord of the Ming Dynasty is dozens of years younger and more handsome than Liu Ni. Even if my sister is his concubine, it will be many times better than being Liu Ni's wife and staying a widow.
Looking at Liu Hanchang who was waiting outside like him, Gan Erlang smiled and said: "It seems that this person from Mingfu is very generous!"
Liu Hanchang smiled and said, "Erlang, I have never had the opportunity to tell you that from now on in Donghai, there will be no Ming Palace, only the king. The Ming Palace you are talking about is the king of the country. Do you hear me? From now on, I will be called the king! The Holy Emperor will grant the title of Donghai Kingdom, and the king of the country will be the county prince."
Gan Erlang was stunned: "Huh?" He didn't react for a while.
Seal the country? Which dynasty and generation did this happen to?
County official? Second rank honor?
Just the young man just now?
Ganjiro suddenly felt a little soft in his calves.
But then, I was ecstatic again, sister, is the slave of the king? If you really become a concubine, you will really enter a wealthy family!
If you are favored again!
The entire Gan family, don’t want to become famous again?
…
Minghu Manor, with its pavilions and pavilions, is very exquisite and has the style of Mingyuan in the south of the Yangtze River.
At this time, the living room of the inner house was filled with candlelight. Neither Gan nor Li were asleep, waiting for Lu Ning to turn around.
Mrs. Gan just took over Mrs. Li and moved them into this villa according to Lu Ning's instructions. She also had something she wanted to ask Lu Ning about.
There has been no news from the outside world. I just heard that my second brother was imprisoned.
Mrs. Gan was very anxious. Although this brother had a flashy temper, he was still a blood relative.
Mrs. Gan wondered if she could beg Lu Ning to let her second brother go. Maybe he could agree to it because of his love for protecting his family in the past?
However, if he refuses, his face will not matter now, but second brother, how can he endure the hardship of prison? I am afraid that I will die of illness in a few days.
Looking at the dim candlelight, Mrs. Li felt extremely distressed and said, "Mother, it's better to put out the candle..."
"Old madam, you, don't call me slave like that again." Mrs. Gan came back to her senses.
She was still reserved when facing Lu Ning. From the beginning to the end, she never called Lu Ning "lord" or "master", nor did she call herself a slave or maid. Although she abided by the etiquette of a slave and responded to claims of courtesy, she had her own reserve.
However, in front of this kind woman who was still extremely respectful to her, Mrs. Gan lost her reserve. In fact, it was the same as in the past. Why didn't she hope that a loving mother like Mrs. Li would love and cherish her as much as her son, unlike her own relatives who wanted to give herself to a bad old man for marriage in order to make the family more prosperous.
Therefore, she has no qualms about respecting Mrs. Li as her mother.
But Mrs. Li felt extremely uncomfortable in her heart. Her mistress, who used to be aloof and aloof, had now become her slave, bowing three steps and kowtowing to her every five steps. She felt that if time went by, her life would be shortened.
Hearing that Mrs. Li was about to extinguish the candle, Mrs. Gan responded, and Bingting came to the candlestick, "Old madam, you can rest early. When you get up tomorrow morning, you can also see the county prince!" She said as she prepared to blow out the candle.
At this moment, there was a rush outsideThere was a sound of hurried footsteps, but it was Xiaocui, Mrs. Gan's former personal maid, who ran in and said hurriedly: "Mistress..." Then she got up and quickly prostrated, and said to Mrs. Li: "Old madam, the mistress is back!"
Her mistress was originally named Gan, but she suddenly came to her senses and realized that she and Gan were originally masters and servants, but now they are both maids. This change of status was also torturous for her. Behind others, she still regarded Gan as mistress, but in front of others, they had to have the same status, which made her very psychologically burdened.
Similarly, Mrs. Gan was extremely ashamed when facing Xiao Cui. How embarrassed was she when her mistress became a maid, facing her former maid?
As he was talking, there were already footsteps outside. Lu Ning strode in. Seeing that his mother was not asleep, he was slightly startled and then said politely, "Mother, I want to take Mrs. Gan out. You should rest early."
In today's world, traveling at night is particularly dangerous, especially for my mother. Although the distance from the county seat to Ganjia Village is only more than thirty miles, my mother knows that she will be worried to death if she travels at night.
